I'll pick a typical aromatase inhibitor and query the EHR data. First let me look at the available clinical tables.
This is a standard OMOP CDM. I'll use **anastrozole**, a typical aromatase inhibitor. Let me find its concept and count breast-cancer patients who received it.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) LIKE '%anastrozole%'
  AND domain_id = 'Drug'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, concept_name
LIMIT 20

The ingredient concept is `1348265` (anastrozole). I'll count distinct breast-cancer patients who received any anastrozole drug, using the concept ancestor to capture all descendant drug products, and SNOMED "malignant neoplasm of breast" descendants for the condition.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS breast_cancer_patients_on_anastrozole
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_drug
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca_drug.descendant_concept_id
 AND ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id = 1348265   -- anastrozole ingredient
WHERE de.person_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_cond
      ON co.condition_concept_id = ca_cond.descendant_concept_id
     AND ca_cond.ancestor_concept_id = 4112853  -- Malignant tumor of breast
)

Method: counted distinct `person_id`s in `drug_exposure` for any drug descending from the anastrozole ingredient (`concept_id 1348265`), restricted to patients with a breast-cancer condition (any descendant of "Malignant tumor of breast", `concept_id 4112853`).
